verdict.rationale: Expensify's docs claim SmartScan automatically reads merchant/date/total/currency from a snapped photo (expensify-docs-6), but hands-on community reports describe ~70% miscategorization rates, slow multi-minute processing, and reveal that 'SmartScan' relies partly on human Mechanical Turk workers manually transcribing receipts rather than pure OCR (expensify-comm-1, expensify-comm-4, expensify-comm-5, expensify-comm-2, expensify-comm-3) — directly contradicting the polished automated experience implied. Missing for 10: no evidence of the 'forward an email' receipt capture path, no evidence of automatic matching of receipts to the correct card transaction, and no rebuttal/updated evidence addressing the accuracy/privacy concerns raised.
